facts.activity_file: proving dead and testing for zero energy

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: kinetic release during routine operation on P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during routine operation while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 3 April 2021 an incident occurred on P-3220 and M-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
